scene: The defeated automaton bows politely, unlocking the pavilion’s three departure gates.
picture: A flat side view along the exit colonnade of the pavilion. On the far left waits a red-canopied wicker rickshaw. The player stands left of centre with his cane. In the centre rests a small yellow hand-cranked trolley on tracks. On the far right, a green water taxi waits at canal steps.
shown: a wicker rickshaw with a waiting puller on the far left
a yellow hand-cranked trolley standing on rails in the centre
a green wooden water taxi bobbing by steps on the far right

variants.scene: Three grand departure gates swing open under the glowing platform lanterns.
The brass figure bows low, granting you passage to continue seeking {quest}.
Cool canal air drifts inside as three different rides await your choice.
